title: Nox & Pico — « Elle t’éclaire. Nuance. » (sketch IA, début de l’épisode 1)
decisions: Teaser, accepted as such: the hook asks why the watch makes green lights and the film ends on "Nuance." (l04b), before the answer, which starts at l05. The comedy closes, the question does not: the sketch is a part 1. The follow-up is announced outside the 4:3 picture (post text or pinned comment), and l05 to l07 are the material of a second sketch. No line changes. Owner to confirm.

Style master: where the two approved images differ in rendering (nox_ref is grittier and more pixel-edged, pico_ref smoother), new stills follow nox_ref: only shot 1, in the hallway, then keeps the smoother look. Owner may overrule before the stills are made (STYLE_MASTER in the build scripts).

Stills in dependency order: deux_etabli first (3 or 4 candidates, the owner picks one), together with nox_tgp; then the four others with the approved deux_etabli as an extra reference (same room, same props, same poses). Stills are generated at 1K.

Shot 7 is played on ots_nox, not on the soldering close-up: Pico's wrist and watch are in front of Nox in shots 3, 4 and 6 and would vanish on a frame without her. The other fix that was proposed (she snatches her wrist back during the silent shot 6) was not kept: it adds a large arm move to the only frame with two faces, and fails if shot 6 is dropped.
Shot 8: the start image is nox_ref tightened by a 1.2x crop, which takes the dismantled watch lying on the bench out of the frame; the line comes first, the glasses gesture after it.

Shot 9: the picture is generated silent and the sound always comes from take 9b (Nox on screen). Pico's double-take is played once: eyes round on the watch in shot 9, the look up to Nox on "quoi ?!" in shot 10.
Pico answers tit for tat (no held silence before "J'ai jamais regardé dessous, ok ?"); the only silence of the middle of the film is shot 6. Nox always speaks at full voice (no whisper, no hush).
Captions: one card per shot; two timed cards in shots 4, 9 and 11, so that the second half of the line is not readable before the pause that protects it.
Sound: clips are generated with the voice only; shots 6 and 9 with generate_audio off. Room tone, sound effects and music are laid in the edit.

setups.framing: Medium single of Pico, frontal, eye level, waist up (approved image, used as is)
setups.description: The approved image pico_ref.png is the start image, used as is. Start file stills/pico_porte.png: the same picture saved without transparency and trimmed by a few pixels to an exact 4:3 (1192x894), made by prep_refs.py; nothing is generated. Camera inside the workshop on Nox's side of the bench (his point of view), about 2.5 m from the door, at standing eye height. Pico has just stopped in the open doorway, centred, facing the lens; her left forearm is raised across her chest with the smartwatch toward the camera, brows frowned, mouth closed. Behind her: the dark brick hallway, a metal shelf with books and a small green LED string, a pendant lamp top right; the grey door leaf stands open at screen-left; dark workshop wall in the left foreground. Used for shot 1 only, and for the voice tests.

setups.framing: Close-up of Nox at his soldering, low angle from bench level, three-quarter front
setups.description: Camera resting on the workbench top on Nox's right-hand side (the soldering-station side), about 40 cm from his hands, tilted up about 25 degrees at his face, which is bowed over his work; his body is turned three-quarters toward screen-right. Bottom of the frame: his right hand holds the soldering iron (blue handle) still, its tip resting on a small green circuit board, a thin wisp of smoke: a held pose, not an action, because fine hand work is what video models do worst. His face fills the upper two-thirds: eyes lowered and clearly visible behind pale transparent lenses, mouth closed, rebel lock of hair. Because the camera is low, the bowed face is seen almost frontally: the mouth must be fully visible and above the bottom fifth of the frame (caption zone). Behind and above him: dark bookshelves, the string of round green bulbs, the plain glow of one CRT monitor, a slice of the night window at the right edge. Nobody else in frame; no watch on the bench; the soldering stand is out of frame (the iron is in his hand; nox_ref shows it in its stand, and two irons must not appear). His earbud is in the far ear and is not visible. References: nox_ref for the character, then the approved deux_etabli for the room, the bench props and his pose. Used for shot 2 and for the safety takes 2b and 7b. Spare still if the hand or the iron deforms in the clips: nox_soudure_sans_main. Common to every new still: the rendering of the style master (nox_ref by default: its outline weight, flat shading and slightly pixelled edges), with the palette and night lighting of the approved images; 4:3, generated at 1K (the approved images are 1200x896 and the clips 720p: a 2K still would have finer lines than shots 1 and 8); no text, letters or numbers anywhere (monitor screens show a plain pale-blue glow with blank rectangles, pinned notes are blank paper); Pico: red high ponytail with GREEN elastic, long strands round the face, yellow sweatshirt, black headphones round her neck, black smartwatch on her LEFT wrist, the only watch of the film; Nox: blue-black spiky hair with a rebel lock, thin glasses with pale transparent green-tinted lenses (both eyes always visible through them, no glare), black turtleneck, anthracite bomber with green zip trim, earbud in his LEFT ear (hidden whenever his left side is turned away); screen direction for the whole film: Nox on the left looking right, Pico on the right looking left (the camera never crosses to the window side of the Nox-door axis: it stays on that axis or on Nox's right-hand side). Ask for it as a NEW camera angle with the approved images as image_references, never as a copy of them.

Just above the forearm, only her eyes, eyebrows, forehead and red fringe are visible, about 10 cm behind the watch and lit green from below; her nose, mouth and chin are hidden behind the forearm. Eyes narrowed in a sceptical squint, fixed on the watch. Background dark and simple (plain navy wall, a hint of the door frame). The bench surface fills the bottom fifth of the frame (caption zone). spare_stills.when: pico_yeux_montre fails three times (full face above the arm, digits on the watch, deformed hand). Easy picture that keeps the green light in the film; the eyes are lost, so the reaction is carried by shot 10 alone.

shots.speaker: pico
shots.text: Nox ! Pourquoi ma montre fait des lumières vertes à la fin de mon run ?
caption: Nox ! Pourquoi ma montre fait des lumières vertes à la fin de mon run ?
shots.acting: She has just skidded to a stop, out of breath; no hello. "Nox !" sharp, then the question, urgent and pressing, quick but clearly articulated, very intrigued (the breathlessness is heard before the first word, not inside the sentence). One beat: she shakes her raised watch wrist toward him once on "ma montre", eyes locked on him (the lens). After the last word she holds the wrist up and the stare, mouth closed.
shots.listener: Nox is off-screen (the camera is his point of view).
shots.camera: Locked. The clip opens on the posed still, door already open.
shots.sfx: Door bang on the first frame; a short sneaker squeak under it (optional).
shots.notes: The caption of the question is on screen from 0.1 s: it is the hook (two lines: "Nox ! Pourquoi ma montre fait" / "des lumières vertes à la fin de mon run ?"). Longest line (14 words): frontal, medium size, one mouth. "run" is the English word as French runners say it. A faint green flicker under the watch case is welcome but must not be forced. This clip is also the Pico clip of the voice tests: it needs no new still.

shots.speaker: nox
caption: Bonsoir à toi aussi, Pico.
shots.acting: First sentence of l02. He does not react: bowed over his work, motionless, the iron tip resting on the board, through one silent second. Then he says it to his circuit board without looking up: brisk, wry, exaggeratedly polite, mock-offended, a smile in the voice. No gesture and no change of face: his non-reaction is the joke.
shots.listener: Pico is off-screen; her sneaker steps cross the room under the silent second (added in the edit).
shots.sfx: Faint soldering sizzle; Pico's quick steps approaching under the silent second and the line, cut dead by the clatter on the cut into shot 3.
shots.notes: The silent second before the deadpan answer is the first laugh (as reference 2, shot 11). If the model starts speaking at once, hold the first frame in the edit. Safety take 2b on this same still: the whole of l02 in one clip (about 4.2 s), which replaces shots 2 and 3 if the two-shot fails. Shots 2 and 3 are the two halves of one line: played back to back they must sound like one utterance (same pitch, level and energy).

shots.speaker: nox
caption: Entre, fais comme chez toi.
shots.acting: Second sentence of l02. The hard cut reveals that she is already sprawled on his bench with the watch under his nose: the laugh is on the cut, and the tableau is held for almost a second before the line. He stays bowed over his work; one beat: he lifts his head a few centimetres, just enough to look at her over the watch. Warm, amused sarcasm, an old habit between them, brisk.
shots.listener: Pico frozen, wrist held 15 cm from his glasses, staring at him, eyebrow raised, lips closed. Her stillness is the joke.
shots.camera: Locked. Almost one second on the tableau before the line, so that the reveal reads (reference 1 gives its wide gag frames more than 3 s).
shots.sfx: A short clatter of components exactly on the cut (her elbows landing on the bench); the footsteps stop on it.
shots.notes: The only speaking shot with two visible faces: the prompt names the speaker (the young man on the left) and says the young woman on the right keeps her lips closed and does not move. Short line (6 syllables), in profile. If her lips move anyway: remake the still with her head turned further from the camera. If the still itself fails: use safety takes 2b and 7b and drop shots 3 and 6.

shots.speaker: nox
shots.text: Tu portes cette montre depuis deux ans… et tu découvres qu'elle s'allume ?
caption: Tu portes cette montre depuis deux ans…
et tu découvres qu’elle s’allume ?
shots.acting: Kept whole so that the pause plays in real time. Teasing, deadpan-playful, brisk, a smile in the voice. His eyes are on the watch for "Tu portes cette montre depuis deux ans…"; one beat: on the "…" he looks up at her over the top of his glasses with a corner smile (only his eyes move, his head stays bowed), then finishes the question lightly, enjoying it.
shots.listener: Pico's shoulder and raised wrist in the foreground do not move.
shots.camera: Locked. The one shot above 4 s.
shots.notes: 12 words on a three-quarter face of medium size, never on a close-up, so that a lip-sync slip shows least. The "…" is a short held pause, not a slowdown. Two caption cards: the second half appears only after the pause. No raised eyebrow for Nox: that is Pico's signature. Spare take 4b: the same line on nox_face (made anyway as part of the voice tests).

shots.speaker: pico
caption: J’ai jamais regardé dessous, ok ?
shots.acting: Stung, she snaps back at once, tit for tat: fast, defensive, a bit sulky. One beat: on "ok ?" she lifts her chin and pouts, glaring straight back at him (toward the left edge of the frame); she holds the sulky glare.
shots.notes: First use of the Pico close-up. No silence before her line: the held silence is Nox's device, not hers. Her sulky glare at him is the look she still has in shot 6. Listen for the word "ok" (two syllables, as okay).

shots.speaker: none
shots.acting: Silent stand-off. Exactly the tableau of shot 3: he is already back at his circuit board and does not look at her; she is still planted on his bench, wrist under his nose, glaring at him (the sulky glare that ends shot 5). Nothing moves except the wisp of smoke.
shots.listener: Both hold perfectly still, lips closed.
shots.camera: Locked. Same still as shot 3 (reference 1 also reuses its wide before and after the gag).
shots.sfx: Soldering sizzle and room tone only (the clip is generated without sound). Optional: one short amused breath through the nose from Nox on the last frames, leading into his "Bon.".
shots.notes: The only silence of this passage, played with both characters in frame. Generated with generate_audio off, from the same still as shot 3; failing that, the still itself held for 1.3 s. If the shot is dropped in the edit, shot 7 is replaced by take 7b (the soldering close-up), so that the over-the-shoulder frame does not come twice in a row for Nox.

shots.speaker: nox
caption: Bon. Laisse-moi t’expliquer.
shots.acting: "Bon." short and falling, amused and resigned (he gives in), eyes still down on the watch. One beat: he lifts his head toward her (toward the right edge of the frame) and the rest brightens, eager and brisk: "Laisse-moi t'expliquer." (he loves explaining).
shots.listener: Pico's shoulder and raised wrist in the foreground do not move.
shots.notes: Played over Pico's shoulder, not on the soldering close-up: her wrist and watch are in front of his face in shots 3, 4 and 6 and would vanish on a hard cut to a frame without her. Same still as shot 4, two shots apart, with a different beat (shot 4: only his eyes come up; shot 7: his whole head). The amused sigh is no longer asked of the model (it could come out as a word): it is a sound added at the end of shot 6. Safety take 7b: the same line on nox_soudure, for the cut without the two-shot.

shots.speaker: nox
caption: Regarde de plus près.
shots.acting: First sentence of l03, his catchphrase: playful and inviting, a grin in it, at full voice, brisk. One beat, AFTER the line: he pushes his glasses up with one index finger, a small green glint on the rim of one lens; the cut to shot 9 lands on that glint.
shots.listener: Pico is off-screen (the camera is her point of view).
shots.sfx: A tiny glint sound on the glasses.
shots.notes: His signature before every revelation (the revelation is shot 9). The gesture comes after the line: the hand is never near the mouth while he speaks, and if the gesture comes out badly the shot is cut right after the last word. His eyes stay visible through the lenses the whole time. Take 8b: no hand and no glint (he leans a little toward the lens); the glint is then a sound only. Ask for a perfectly still background with frozen screens. Five syllables in a 5 s clip: check that no word is added and that the delivery is not stretched. Shots 8 and 9 are the two halves of one line: same voice, same energy.

shots.speaker: nox
shots.text: Ta montre envoie de la lumière verte… dans ta peau.
caption: Ta montre envoie de la lumière verte…
dans ta peau.
shots.acting: Second sentence of l03, spoken OFF-SCREEN by Nox. The sound is that of take 9b (Nox on screen, over her shoulder), laid over this picture in the edit. Lively storyteller relish, at full voice; a short suspense pause after "verte…", then "dans ta peau." a little lower and closer, fully voiced and clearly articulated, with mock mystery.
shots.listener: Pico is on screen and has taken "look closer" literally: crouched, eyes 10 cm from the watch, squinting, green light pulsing on her skin. One beat: on "dans ta peau" her squint drops and her eyes go round, still fixed on the watch; she freezes. She does not look up at him: that look is kept for "quoi ?!" in shot 10. Her mouth stays hidden behind her forearm, which does not move.
shots.sfx: A soft, low electronic pulse in time with the green light (optional).
shots.notes: The image of the sketch: the green light on her skin, the subject of the episode, shown rather than told. The picture is generated without sound (generate_audio off): an off-screen voice could come out in the wrong voice, in the young woman's mouth, or not at all. In the edit the sound of take 9b is placed so that "dans ta peau" falls on her eyes going round. Two caption cards: "dans ta peau." appears only after the pause. If the still fails: the spare insert montre_lueur (forearm, watch, green glow, no face); as a last resort, take 9b as picture and sound.

shots.speaker: pico
caption: Attends… quoi ?! Elle me scanne ?!
shots.acting: Her signature double-take, played once. The shot opens as her eyes are already dropping toward her wrist (below the frame), carrying on from shot 9: "Attends…" low and stunned, eyes down; one beat: on "quoi ?!" her head jerks up and her wide eyes snap to Nox (toward the left edge of the frame); then "Elle me scanne ?!" loud, rising, a touch of panic. She holds the shocked face after the last word.
shots.notes: The line stays whole in one clip: split in two it would give two clips of 3 syllables that the model pads with invented words, and two voices for one outcry. Same still as shot 5, but her previous appearance is the eyes-over-watch shot, so the framing is not repeated twice in a row. In the edit the shot starts when her eyes are already down. Listen for the word "scanne".

shots.speaker: nox
caption: Elle t’éclaire.
Nuance.
shots.acting: A silent deadpan stare for 1.2 s, with one slow blink. Then, precise and amused, at an easy conversational pace: "Elle t'éclaire.", a tiny pause, and "Nuance." placed crisply, with a falling tone, like a full stop. One beat: the corner of his mouth lifts after "Nuance."; he holds the smirk 0.7 s to the final cut. Deadpan in the face, alive in the voice.
shots.camera: Slow push-in of about 12-15% over the whole shot, the only camera move of the film. Generate the clip locked and do the push-in in the edit; plan B (take 11b) is to ask the model for a very slow push-in.
shots.sfx: None: the music bed stops on the cut into this shot, so that the stare and the line play over silence.
shots.notes: Punchline and end of the film (as the last shot of reference 1: silent stare, line, faint smirk). "Nuance." is the punchline word: neither swallowed nor rising like a question. Two caption cards: "Nuance." appears only when he says it. The approved direction says "très posé": that is played in the face and in the pause, not in a slow voice, which makes him robotic.

music: A discreet, slow lo-fi loop (soft bass, no lead melody, no vocals), mixed about 16 dB under the voices, entering just after the door bang and cut dead on the cut into shot 11 so that the stare and the punchline play over silence.
sound_bed: The clips are generated with the voice only (no room tone asked of the model: eleven generated ambiences would change at every cut and would spoil a later voice-change pass). One continuous, very quiet room tone is laid under the whole film in the edit, with the sound effects listed shot by shot.
open_questions: Voice: does an audio reference make the character speak in that exact voice, clip after clip, and how good is the French? Tested before anything else with the two approved images only: batch A (8 clips: l01 on pico_porte and l02b on nox_face, on seedance_2_0 and seedance_2_5, with and without the voice sample), batch A2 (8 clips: the two other ways of attaching the sample), then batch B on the winner (9 clips: repeat, another line, a control, the line itself as audio, and 4 s against 6 s). Details in prompts.json (voice_test) and runbook.md.

Voice samples: are there clean recordings of 11-13 s, without music, of the two validated voices (Nox: Umbriel, Pico: Laomedeia)? seedance_2_0 only takes audio references of 2-15 s. Texts and rules: prompts.json (tts_samples).

If the voices still drift from clip to clip, is a voice-change pass after generation acceptable (same timing, so the lips still match)? Its cost and its availability during the trial must be read first: the trial gives no credits and the balance is 10.
Style master: nox_ref by default (see decisions). Confirm, or choose pico_ref.
Teaser: the film ends before the answer to its own hook (see decisions). Confirm, and say where the follow-up is announced.

An alternative shot 10 would need one more still: the side two-shot again, with Pico recoiled, arm outstretched, and Nox sipping his coffee, the mug hiding his mouth (from the comedy-first proposal). Wanted?
Length: 32.6 s estimated from syllable counts (expect 30-36 s with generated speech). If the cut lands under 30 s, lengthen the silent beats of shots 2, 6 and 11 rather than add a shot?
The room will not match perfectly from one angle to the next (it does not in reference 2 either): acceptable as long as the characters, the props and the screen direction hold?
Captions: white with a dark outline at the bottom (reference 1), one card per shot and two timed cards in shots 4, 9 and 11, with "ok" kept in lower case as in the approved text?
